svg.title: Waste collection worker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as waste collection worker, wearing a safety vest and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A tapered lidded collection bin has a broad upper handle and two separated low wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
